title.zh: 電話信令 CAS 與 CCS：原理與設定
title.en: Telephony Signaling: CAS & CCS — Concepts and Configuration

voice.style: 台灣口音的年輕女性，溫暖、清楚、說故事的語氣，語速適中
voice.styleEn: Young female voice with a Taiwanese Mandarin accent, warm and clear storytelling tone, moderate pace

sentences.zh: 拿起話筒、撥號、對方響鈴，接著通話，最後掛斷。
sentences.en: Lift the handset, dial, the far end rings, you talk, and finally hang up.

sentences.zh: 除了聲音，線路還得傳遞這些控制訊息，也就是信令 Signaling。
sentences.en: Besides the voice, the line must carry these control messages. That is signaling.

sentences.zh: 在數位中繼線上，信令主要有兩種：隨路信令 CAS 與共路信令 CCS。
sentences.en: On digital trunks there are two main kinds: Channel Associated Signaling (CAS) and Common Channel Signaling (CCS).

sentences.zh: 差別在於：信令是跟著每個語音通道走，還是集中在一條專用通道。
sentences.en: The difference: does signaling ride with each voice channel, or gather on one dedicated channel?

chapters.zh: T1 與 E1 的骨架

sentences.zh: 先認識載體：T1 有 24 個時槽，每個 DS0 是 64 kbps。
sentences.en: First, the carrier: a T1 has 24 timeslots, each a 64 kbps DS0.

sentences.zh: 一個訊框有 193 位元，每秒 8000 個訊框，總速率 1.544 Mbps。
sentences.en: A frame is 193 bits, 8,000 frames per second, for 1.544 Mbps in total.
sentences.tts: 一個訊框有一百九十三個位元，每秒八千個訊框，總速率一點五四四 Mbps。

sentences.zh: 多出來的那 1 個位元，是做訊框同步用的 framing bit。
sentences.en: The one extra bit is the framing bit, used for frame synchronization.

sentences.zh: E1 則有 32 個時槽，總速率 2.048 Mbps。
sentences.en: An E1 has 32 timeslots, for 2.048 Mbps in total.
sentences.tts: E1 則有三十二個時槽，總速率二點零四八 Mbps。

sentences.zh: 時槽 0 負責訊框同步，時槽 16 通常保留給信令。
sentences.en: Timeslot 0 handles frame alignment; timeslot 16 is usually reserved for signaling.

sentences.zh: 所以一條 E1，一般可以承載 30 路語音。
sentences.en: So an E1 typically carries 30 voice channels.

sentences.zh: CAS 的意思是：信令跟著每一個語音通道走。
sentences.en: CAS means signaling travels with each individual voice channel.

sentences.zh: 每一路都有自己的狀態位元，用來表示摘機或掛機。
sentences.en: Every channel has its own state bits, indicating off-hook or on-hook.

sentences.zh: 常見的線路信令有 Loop Start、Ground Start，以及 E&M。
sentences.en: Common line signaling types are Loop Start, Ground Start, and E&M.
sentences.tts: 常見的線路信令有 Loop Start、Ground Start，以及 E and M。

sentences.zh: E&M 又分成 Immediate、Wink、Delay Dial 等啟動方式。
sentences.en: E&M has start modes such as Immediate, Wink, and Delay Dial.
sentences.tts: E and M 又分成 Immediate、Wink、Delay Dial 等啟動方式。

sentences.zh: 以 Wink Start 為例：一端先佔用線路，
sentences.en: Take Wink Start: one side seizes the line first,

sentences.zh: 對端回一個短暫的 wink，才開始送出號碼。
sentences.en: the far end answers with a brief wink, and only then are digits sent.

sentences.zh: 號碼本身，通常用 DTMF 或 MF 音頻，在語音通道內傳送。
sentences.en: The digits themselves are usually sent in-band, as DTMF or MF tones.

sentences.zh: 那 T1 的狀態位元放在哪裡？答案是：借來的。
sentences.en: So where do T1 state bits live? The answer: they are borrowed.

sentences.zh: 在 SF 超訊框的第 6 與第 12 個訊框，
sentences.en: In the SF superframe, in frames 6 and 12,

sentences.zh: 每個時槽的最低位元，會被拿去當 A、B 信令位元。
sentences.en: the least significant bit of every timeslot becomes the A and B signaling bits.

sentences.zh: ESF 則在第 6、12、18、24 個訊框，提供 A、B、C、D 四個位元。
sentences.en: ESF uses frames 6, 12, 18, and 24, providing four bits: A, B, C, and D.

sentences.zh: 這就是 Robbed-Bit Signaling，位元竊取。
sentences.en: This is called robbed-bit signaling.

sentences.zh: 對語音幾乎聽不出差別，但資料傳輸只能安全使用 56 kbps。
sentences.en: Voice barely notices, but data can only safely use 56 kbps.

sentences.zh: E1 的 CAS 不偷位元，而是把信令放在時槽 16。
sentences.en: E1 CAS doesn't rob bits; it places signaling in timeslot 16.

sentences.zh: 16 個訊框組成一個多訊框，第 0 個訊框負責多訊框同步。
sentences.en: Sixteen frames form a multiframe; frame 0 carries the multiframe alignment.

sentences.zh: 其餘 15 個訊框，每個帶兩路的 ABCD 位元，剛好涵蓋 30 路。
sentences.en: Each of the other 15 frames carries ABCD bits for two channels, covering all 30.

sentences.zh: 雖然位置集中，但每組位元固定對應某一路，所以仍然是 CAS。
sentences.en: Though grouped together, each bit group maps to a fixed channel, so it is still CAS.

sentences.zh: 常見的 MFC-R2，就是用這些位元做線路信令，
sentences.en: The widely used MFC-R2 uses these bits for line signaling,

sentences.zh: 再用語音通道內的多頻互控音，傳遞號碼。
sentences.en: and compelled multi-frequency tones inside the voice channel to pass the digits.

sentences.zh: CCS 換了一個思路：把所有通道的信令，集中在一條專用通道。
sentences.en: CCS takes another approach: signaling for all channels goes on one dedicated channel.

sentences.zh: 信令不再只是幾個位元，而是有結構的訊息。
sentences.en: Signaling is no longer just a few bits, but structured messages.

sentences.zh: 在企業常見的 ISDN PRI 裡，這條通道叫做 D 通道。
sentences.en: In ISDN PRI, common in enterprises, this channel is called the D channel.

sentences.zh: T1 PRI 是 23B+D，D 通道在時槽 24。
sentences.en: T1 PRI is 23B+D, with the D channel on timeslot 24.
sentences.tts: T1 PRI 是 23 B 加 D，D 通道在時槽 24。

sentences.zh: E1 PRI 是 30B+D，D 通道在時槽 16。
sentences.en: E1 PRI is 30B+D, with the D channel on timeslot 16.
sentences.tts: E1 PRI 是 30 B 加 D，D 通道在時槽 16。

sentences.zh: 電信業者之間，則使用另一套 CCS：七號信令 SS7。
sentences.en: Between carriers, another CCS system is used: Signaling System No. 7, or SS7.

sentences.zh: 對網路工程師來說，這很像 SIP 與 RTP：信令和媒體分開走。
sentences.en: For network engineers, it is much like SIP and RTP: signaling and media travel separately.

sentences.zh: D 通道的第二層是 Q.921，也就是 LAPD；第三層是 Q.931。
sentences.en: The D channel runs Q.921, also known as LAPD, at Layer 2, and Q.931 at Layer 3.
sentences.tts: D 通道的第二層是 Q 點 921，也就是 LAPD；第三層是 Q 點 931。

sentences.zh: 發話端送出 SETUP，帶著被叫號碼與要使用的 B 通道。
sentences.en: The calling side sends SETUP, carrying the called number and the B channel to use.

sentences.zh: 對端回 CALL PROCEEDING，接著用 ALERTING 表示正在響鈴。
sentences.en: The far end replies CALL PROCEEDING, then ALERTING while the phone rings.

sentences.zh: 對方接聽時送出 CONNECT，再以 CONNECT ACK 確認。
sentences.en: When answered, it sends CONNECT, confirmed with CONNECT ACK.

sentences.zh: 掛斷則依序是 DISCONNECT、RELEASE、RELEASE COMPLETE。
sentences.en: Hang-up follows DISCONNECT, RELEASE, then RELEASE COMPLETE.

sentences.zh: 拆線訊息都帶有 Cause Code，排錯時非常好用。
sentences.en: Clearing messages carry a cause code, which is very handy for troubleshooting.

sentences.zh: 把兩者並排比較一下。
sentences.en: Let's compare the two side by side.

sentences.zh: CAS 簡單、相容老設備，但能傳遞的資訊有限。
sentences.en: CAS is simple and compatible with legacy equipment, but carries limited information.

sentences.zh: CCS 能傳送來電號碼、失敗原因等豐富資訊，
sentences.en: CCS can carry rich information such as calling number and failure cause,

sentences.zh: 而且每個 B 通道都保有完整的 64 kbps。
sentences.en: and every B channel keeps the full, clear 64 kbps.

sentences.zh: 代價是 T1 PRI 要讓出一個時槽給 D 通道，只剩 23 路。
sentences.en: The trade-off: T1 PRI gives one timeslot to the D channel, leaving 23 bearers.

sentences.zh: 不過透過 NFAS，一條 D 通道可以控制多條 T1。
sentences.en: But with NFAS, a single D channel can control multiple T1s.

sentences.zh: 動手設定前，先跟電信業者或對端確認參數。
sentences.en: Before configuring, confirm the parameters with the carrier or the far end.

sentences.zh: T1 要確認訊框是 SF 還是 ESF，線路編碼是 AMI 還是 B8ZS。
sentences.en: For T1: framing SF or ESF, and line coding AMI or B8ZS.

sentences.zh: E1 要確認是否啟用 CRC4，線路編碼通常是 HDB3。
sentences.en: For E1: whether CRC4 is enabled; line coding is usually HDB3.

sentences.zh: 時脈來源通常設為 line，跟隨電信端。
sentences.en: Clock source is usually set to line, following the carrier.

sentences.zh: 以 Cisco IOS 為例，CAS 用 ds0-group 指定時槽與信令類型。
sentences.en: In Cisco IOS, CAS uses ds0-group to set the timeslots and signaling type.
sentences.tts: 以 Cisco IOS 為例，CAS 用 D S zero group 指定時槽與信令類型。

sentences.zh: 系統會產生對應的 voice-port，再用 dial-peer 指向它。
sentences.en: This creates a matching voice-port, and a dial-peer then points to it.

sentences.zh: 如果是 PRI，先設定 ISDN switch-type，要與對端一致。
sentences.en: For PRI, first set the ISDN switch-type to match the far end.

sentences.zh: 在 controller 底下，用 pri-group 指定時槽。
sentences.en: Under the controller, use pri-group to specify the timeslots.

sentences.zh: T1 會產生 Serial 介面 :23，E1 則是 :15，代表 D 通道。
sentences.en: T1 creates a Serial interface ending in :23, E1 one ending in :15; it represents the D channel.
sentences.tts: T1 會產生 Serial 介面冒號二十三，E1 則是冒號十五，代表 D 通道。

sentences.zh: 用 show isdn status 驗證，第二層應顯示 MULTIPLE_FRAME_ESTABLISHED。
sentences.en: Verify with show isdn status; Layer 2 should show MULTIPLE_FRAME_ESTABLISHED.
sentences.tts: 用 show isdn status 驗證，第二層應顯示 multiple frame established。

sentences.zh: 如果出現 slips，多半是兩端時脈來源設定不一致。
sentences.en: If you see slips, the clock sources on the two ends are most likely mismatched.

sentences.zh: CAS 可用 debug vpm signal 觀察位元；PRI 則用 debug isdn q931。
sentences.en: For CAS, debug vpm signal shows the bits; for PRI, use debug isdn q931.
sentences.tts: CAS 可用 debug vpm signal 觀察位元；PRI 則用 debug isdn q 931。

sentences.zh: 記住：CAS 信令跟著通道走，CCS 信令集中在專用通道。
sentences.en: Remember: CAS signaling rides each channel; CCS gathers it on a dedicated channel.

sentences.zh: 兩端參數對齊，就是穩定上線的第一步。謝謝收看！
sentences.en: Matching parameters on both ends is the first step to a stable link. Thanks for watching!

characters.descZh: 會摘機、掛機、撥號的電話。它的每個動作，都要變成信令送出去。
characters.descEn: Goes off-hook, on-hook and dials. Every action it takes must become signaling.

characters.descZh: 企業內的交換機，透過 T1/E1 中繼線和電信局或語音閘道連接。
characters.descEn: The enterprise switch, connected to the carrier or a voice gateway over T1/E1 trunks.

characters.descZh: 提供中繼線與時脈的一端，參數要以它為準。
characters.descEn: Provides the trunk and usually the clock. Match your parameters to it.

characters.descZh: 每節車廂是一個 64 kbps 的 DS0，T1 有 24 節，E1 有 32 節。
characters.descEn: Each car is a 64 kbps DS0. A T1 has 24 cars, an E1 has 32.

characters.descZh: 在特定訊框借走每個時槽的最低位元，拿來當 A/B/C/D 信令位元。
characters.descEn: Borrows the least significant bit of every timeslot in certain frames to use as A/B/C/D bits.

characters.descZh: 專門搬運 Q.931 訊息，一個人負責所有 B 通道的建立與拆線。
characters.descEn: Carries Q.931 messages and handles setup and teardown for every B channel.

characters.descZh: 裝有 T1/E1 模組的路由器，用 controller、voice-port 與 dial-peer 完成設定。
characters.descEn: A router with a T1/E1 module, configured with controller, voice-port and dial-peer.
